Equity Bee
You Built It, Now Own It
September 2019

Problem
People join startups to be a part of something greater than themselves and reap
the fruits of their future success. But in too many cases they can't participate in
the success as they cannot keep their equity.
When startup employees, the builders, leave their companies, they have a limited
amount of time to exercise their stock options before they expire.
Due to the high cost (strike + tax) and risk, most employees are unable to exercise their options.

Solution
EquityBee enables startup builders to get the capital they need to exercise their
stock options before they expire, own their equity, and participate in the future
success of startup they helped build.
